'''Zasha Ranken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Sith Imperial Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Ranken was a promising officer in the final part of the Great War, when [[Rycus Kilran]] took her under his wing. She was onboard Kilran's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], and enjoyed bombarding civilian buildings. During the Cold War, she became the admiral in charge of the [[Imperial Forward Command]]. Ranken would earn the respect of [[Darth Krovos]] during her service to the Empire.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Darth Krovos}}</ref>

[[File:Admiral_Ranken_released.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Ranken released by the Outlander]]
Ranken became one of the few experienced officers to survive the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Ranken desired to join [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander's]] [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] but had no way to contact them. In her search, she came into contact with [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] [[Senator]] [[Tai Cordan]] and [[Malita Tal]], an exiled [[Zakuul]]an and popular holo-dancer. Deciding to search for the Outlander together, the trio formed an alliance. Eventually, they were captured by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]]'s forces and were en route to Zakuul for interrogation as to the Outlander's whereabouts. However, the Alliance [[GEMINI trap|raided]] their transport ship and set them free.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', Ranken is voiced by actress [[Anna Graves]].

===Gameplay alternatives===
Ranken appears in '''Chapter XV: The GEMINI Deception''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''. At the climax of the chapter, the prison transport is set to self-destruct and Outlander must manually deploy the escape pods one at a time. Predictably, the first two escape pods make it to safety but the third is destroyed. Ranken, Tai Cordan and Malita, save two but the third dies. [[Lana Beniko]]'s approval will improve if Ranken is one of the survivors; if not, she will disapprove and comment about it later.

If Ranken was saved, Darth Krovos will mention that the Admiral and her family send their regards to the player in the post-'''Jedi Under Siege''' mission, "'''Hearts and Minds'''".
